newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Barratt Developments ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Barratt Developments ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Wednesday it had affirmed Barratt Developments Plc BBB long-term and A2 short-term ratings.
IBCA said Barratt was Britain's second largest housebuilder with activities also in the U.S.

"Despite continued weak demand for housing during Barratt's last financial year which ended June 1996, the group further increased sales and profits," IBCA said in a statement. "The second phase of its expansion plan is now in progress and Barratt expects to build 11,000 homes a year by the year 2000."
IBCA said new equity raised in May last year would support the increased expenditure on land for this purpose.

"The housing market is currently showing signs of being at its most buoyant for years, especially in the South East where Barratt has focused its recent expansion. Such increased activity may yet prove fragile if threatened by higher interest rates but Barratt has positioned itself well," the agency said.
